proxySaved: Proxy saved and bound to this slot
existingProxyBound: This proxy is already in the pool and is now bound to this slot
bindFailed: Could not bind to this slot
proxyHelp: Credentials are stored without being displayed again. Unsaved pasted proxy details are saved before token exchange to avoid using the old proxy.
description: From an empty slot to ready for requests: create, bind egress, import an account and bootstrap.
bootstrapDisabled: Official bootstrap is disabled in the routing configuration
bootstrapRunning: Bootstrap is already running for this slot
credentialsOnly: Only credentials were changed; bootstrap was not triggered
fullOauthRequired: This slot uses Setup Token / Console API Key credentials. Official bootstrap requires full OAuth.
mockMode: The gateway is in mock mode
missingSlotId: The gateway did not receive a slot ID
slotReady: The slot is ready. You can import an account later.
newSlotHelp: Create an empty slot: choose its platform, runtime, system and specifications. Connect the account in the following steps.
emptySlotHelp: Only slots without accounts are listed.
noEmptySlotsHelp: Every slot already has an account. Create a new one or remove credentials from a slot on the Virtual machines page.
bindSocksHelp: Once the slot is ready, bind a SOCKS5 proxy for both token exchange and forwarding.
boundEgressHelp: Bound to this slot. Selecting or pasting another proxy replaces it.
egressRequiredHelp: Forwarding must use the slot's egress. Select an existing proxy or paste a new one.
accountAfterProxy: After binding egress, exchange credentials here using a cookie, authorization link or official Claude Code.
codexCredentialHelp: Use Codex OAuth or an account file (auth.json), not Setup Token / Console Key.
claudeCredentialHelp: Cookies, authorization links and official Claude Code all use the bound egress. Stay on this page after success to monitor bootstrap.
importLater: Stop here and import an account later
onlineHelp: After adding an account, Claude OAuth slots run official bootstrap automatically and become schedulable on completion.
gptNoBootstrap: GPT slots do not run Claude's official bootstrap.
manualBootstrapHelp: Automatic bootstrap after token exchange is disabled in settings. You can run it manually below.
consoleNoBootstrap: Console Key does not run official bootstrap.
setupNoBootstrap: Setup Token does not run official bootstrap.
invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Check the format and try again.
packageHelp: Create a virtual machine from JSON. If SOCKS5 is included, a proxy is created and bound. An occupied id advances to the next available number.
importWithoutBootstrap: {{message}}, but official bootstrap did not start. {{reason}}
queuedNotProbed: {{id}} bootstrap is queued; the check is incomplete
